name: Count Fersen
source:
“You and I are the only two people here… It’s okay, no one is looking.”

Born in Sweden.
Hobby: Language Study (Swedish, French, German, English, Spanish)
Likes: Beautiful Things
Dislikes: Ugly Things

A nobleman and soldier of Sweden. A gentleman who speaks politely. His personality is earnest, but he makes it a rule to enjoy matters of love and romance. So popular that he is always surrounded by ladies wishing to dance with him at balls. He is close with the Marquis Lafayette, always speaking with him whenever he comes to France.

[From [url=http://dreamer-chan.tumblr.com/post/145074546359/bara-ni-kakusareshi-verite-main-cast]Tumblr[/url]]
